field_descriptions.accepted_answer: The answer(s) that has been accepted as best, typically on a Question/Answer site. Sites vary in their selection mechanisms, e.g. drawing on community opinion and/or the view of the Question author.
field_descriptions.answer_count: The number of answers this question has received.
field_descriptions.edu_question_type: For questions that are part of learning resources (e.g. Quiz), eduQuestionType indicates the format of question being given. Example: "Multiple choice", "Open ended", "Flashcard".
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.parent_item: The parent of a question, answer or item in general. Typically used for Q/A discussion threads e.g. a chain of comments with the first comment being an [[Article]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. See also [[comment]] which points from something to a comment about it.
field_descriptions.suggested_answer: An answer (possibly one of several, possibly incorrect) to a Question, e.g. on a Question/Answer site.
